Cohort sketch: undergrad enrollment proxy × 35-year working-alumni window × 0.72 completion × 0.88 still-living/reachable.
Wealth-to-income: low = 5× (SCF-like median path, college-educated ages ~45–54); high = 12× (mean path plus a top-1% bump). Not SCF microdata.
Annual giving flow = 0.5% of low wealth to 2% of high wealth (all-cause). A modeled 4% athletics-directed slice of that flow is what enters capacity after subtracting booked athletic contributions.
Capacity is an ANNUAL FLOW, not a wealth stock.
